lines.en: label secondbeach2:
scene secondbeachintro1
Ami and the others wind up [[reluctantly] parting ways with me once we make it to the beach to unpack their things and figure out whether or not it’s safe to get changed into their swimsuits.
lines.zh: 我们一到海滩，Ami 她们就 [[reluctantly] 和我分开了，去收拾她们的东西，顺便判断换泳衣到底安不安全。

lines.en: But, judging by the fact that it is freezing out and everyone else I’ve encountered is dressed in their winter clothes, this seems highly unlikely.
lines.zh: 不过，看外面冻成这样，而且我碰到的所有人都穿着冬装，这事看来是相当不可能。

lines.en: Oh, and also Karin had to go get into a fight with her sister or something.
lines.zh: 哦，还有，Karin 好像得去跟她姐姐吵一架什么的。

lines.en: I don’t know, I’m not really trying to get involved.
lines.zh: 我也说不清，反正我没打算掺和。

lines.en: Kirin’s the angry one and I doubt she’d be able to ever hurt her older sister on a more than emotional level, so I’m not worried about anyone getting injured.
lines.zh: 发火的是 Kirin，而且我怀疑她也就只能在情绪上伤到她姐姐，所以我不担心有人会受伤。

lines.en: What I am worried about, though...
lines.zh: 我真正担心的倒是……

lines.en: : Are you guys just going to let Yasu...talk to Yumi?
lines.zh: ：你们就这么放任 Yasu……跟 Yumi 说话？

lines.en: : She’s been quite well behaved as of late, so I have decided to loosen her leash and allow her wildest dreams to run free for a moment or two.
lines.zh: ：她最近表现得相当乖，所以我决定把她的绳子放松一点，让她最狂野的梦想自由奔跑个一时半刻。

lines.en: : Oh, how I wish I could don such dark clothing at this time of year!
lines.zh: ：哦，我多希望自己也能在一年中的这个时候穿上如此漆黑的衣裳！

lines.en: : How do you stand so still with feet yet unsinged by the gaze of what lurks below?!
lines.zh: ：你是如何站得如此纹丝不动，双脚竟还未被那潜伏于下的凝视灼伤？！

lines.en: : I think it’s going pretty well.
lines.zh: ：我觉得进行得挺顺利的。

lines.en: : You two are bad friends.
lines.zh: ：你们俩算什么朋友啊。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro2
: The fuck am I supposed to do about this? She’s clearly off her meds, right?
lines.zh: ：这他妈的我能怎么办？她明摆着没吃药吧？

lines.en: : I’ve been wondering that ever since I met her.
lines.zh: ：从我认识她那天起我就一直在纳闷。

lines.en: : I think she might just be permanently off of them.
lines.zh: ：我觉得她可能就是永久性地停药了。

lines.en: : Do we need to like, call somebody or some shit?
lines.zh: ：我们得打个电话找人之类的吗？

lines.en: : That depends on if you’re okay with using your phone now that you know I pay for it.
lines.zh: ：那得看你还乐不乐意用你的手机了，既然你已经知道是我付的账单。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro3
: Of course I’m okay with using it! It’s not like I have much of a fuckin’ choice, is it?!
lines.zh: ：我当然乐意用！我他妈的又不是有很多选择，对吧？！

lines.en: : Sensei, you pay for the class bully’s phone bill?
lines.zh: ：Sensei，你替班上的恶霸付电话费？

lines.en: : I feel as if this may be enabling her to a certain extent.
lines.zh: ：我觉得这在某种程度上算是纵容她了。

lines.en: : He pays for mine and my sister’s as well.
lines.zh: ：我和我妹妹的也是他付的。

lines.en: : Sensei gets a lot of shit for being a perv and stuff, but he’s actually a really nice guy who’d never hurt anyone or anything.
lines.zh: ：Sensei 因为是个变态什么的挨了不少骂，但他其实是个非常好的人，绝对不会去伤害任何人或任何东西。

lines.en: : At the very least, you should have her perform some sort of service in exchange for such a cumbersome weight on your depressingly thin- {i}ahem...{/i}
lines.zh: ：至少，你也该让她做点什么，来抵偿你那薄得叫人沮丧的钱包上如此沉重的负担——{i}咳哼{/i}……

lines.en: : On your exceedingly standard commoner wallet.
lines.zh: ：我是说，你那极其标准的平民钱包。

lines.en: : Good idea, Touka.
lines.zh: ：好主意，Touka。

lines.en: : Yumi, can you-
lines.zh: ：Yumi，你能不能——

lines.en: : Fuck off! No!
lines.zh: ：滚蛋！不行！

lines.en: : I don’t think she wants to provide any sort of service.
lines.zh: ：我看她是不想提供任何形式的服务。

lines.en: Which is extremely depressing as I had a good amount of them lined up for her.
lines.zh: 这可真是让人沮丧，我为她准备的「服务」还挺多的呢。

lines.en: I doubt she’d fit into Ami’s maid outfit, though, so I should probably take some time to-
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑她穿不下 Ami 的女仆装，所以我大概该花点时间——

lines.en: : Yo! Quit fuckin’ thinkin’ about whatever weird shit it is you’re thinkin’ about and tell me what to do about this...thing!
lines.zh: ：喂！别他妈在脑子里想那些乱七八糟的东西了，快告诉我该怎么对付这个……玩意儿！

lines.en: : Yes, Yumi! I am just a {i}thing!{/i}
lines.zh: ：没错，Yumi！我不过是个{i}玩意儿{/i}！

lines.en: : Unworthy to be even called a human if I’m still so weak that the threads of His choosing play hell upon my skin!
lines.zh: ：若我依旧如此软弱，任由祂所择之线在我皮囊上肆虐，那我连被称为人类都不配！

lines.en: : Praise be!
lines.zh: ：赞美祂！

lines.en: : So anyway, welcome to the beach, I guess.
lines.zh: ：总之，欢迎来到海滩。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro4
: Welcome to you as well, Sensei! You’re gonna be the busy one this weekend, so I hope you’re savoring this moment as much as I am.
lines.zh: ：也欢迎你，Sensei！这周末你会是最忙的那个，所以希望你能像我一样好好品味这一刻。

lines.en: : As true as I expect that statement to be, I’d like to know why you think I’m going to be busy.
lines.zh: ：虽然我料到你说的没错，但我想知道你为什么觉得我会忙。

lines.en: : Because Makoto started asking everyone where you were the second she showed up.
lines.zh: ：因为 Makoto 一到这儿就开始到处问你在哪儿。

lines.en: : She’s been searching for you quite thoroughly, might I add.
lines.zh: ：我补充一句，她找你找得相当彻底。

lines.en: : I do believe I even saw her check the men’s washroom for you. It must be incredibly urgent.
lines.zh: ：我敢说我甚至看见她去男厕所找你了。一定是非常要紧的事。

lines.en: : Nah. Makoto’s just secretly a boy and really self conscious about it.
lines.zh: ：不是。Makoto 其实就是个男的，而且对此特别在意。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro5
: Oh my. How insensitive of me to assume such a thing about him.
lines.zh: ：哎呀。我竟对他做出如此的臆测，真是太不体贴了。

lines.en: : It’s okay. I won’t say anything.
lines.zh: ：没事。我不会说出去的。

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: ：怎么？你们干嘛这么看着我？

lines.en: : Stop taking advantage of Touka’s...gullibility and clear this up before it becomes a dramatic and awkward misunderstanding.
lines.zh: ：别再利用 Touka 的……好骗了，趁还没变成一场又戏剧又尴尬的误会，赶紧说清楚。

lines.en: : But it would have been so funny.
lines.zh: ：可那样会很好笑啊。

lines.en: : And mean to Makoto. She like, {i}just{/i} cleared up the whole thing about the fake relationship with a janitor you told everyone about.
lines.zh: ：而且对 Makoto 很过分。你跟大家说的那个跟清洁工假交往的事，她{i}好不容易才{/i}澄清完。

lines.en: : I didn’t tell {i}everyone{/i}. Just a select few people.
lines.zh: ：我又没告诉{i}所有人{/i}。就那么几个挑出来的人。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault you girls can’t keep secrets to yourselves.
lines.zh: ：你们这些女生守不住秘密，又不是我的错。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro6
: Oh, we certainly can.
lines.zh: ：哦，我们当然守得住。

lines.en: : And on that note, I will now confirm that Makoto is a girl.
lines.zh: ：那么借此机会，我现在正式确认：Makoto 是女生。

lines.en: : Don’t ask me how I know how, though.
lines.zh: ：不过别问我是怎么知道的。

lines.en: : I am quite confused right now.
lines.zh: ：我现在相当困惑。

lines.en: : Yeah. I think you’ll find yourself getting even more confused about certain things as the weekend goes on.
lines.zh: ：是啊。我觉得这个周末过下去，你会发现自己对某些事越来越困惑。

lines.en: : The beach trip is normally a pretty exciting string of events for us that resolves a lot of ongoing issues while introducing several more.
lines.zh: ：海滩旅行对我们来说通常是一串相当精彩的事件，能解决不少悬而未决的问题，同时又引出更多新的。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro7
: How incredibly specific.
lines.zh: ：真是具体得不可思议。

lines.en: : Are you willing to confirm this, Chika? I have learned this morning to distrust every bit of information this man provides me.
lines.zh: ：Chika，你愿意为此作证吗？今天早上我已经学会了不信任这个男人提供的任何信息。

lines.en: : Haha...hah...
: You’re just going to have to take my word for this one, Touka.
lines.zh: ：这个你就只能信我一次了，Touka。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro8
: A-Anyway! Must be kind of weird for your first trip to the beach to be such a cold one, right?!
lines.zh: ：总……总之！第一次来海滩就赶上这么冷的一次，肯定挺怪的吧？！

lines.en: : You’ve never been to the beach before, Touka?
lines.zh: ：你以前没来过海滩吗，Touka？

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro9
: Not one even half as...quaint as this one.
lines.zh: ：没来过哪怕有这里一半……别致的海滩。

lines.en: : I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume your family owns a private beach?
lines.zh: ：我斗胆猜一句，你家是不是有私人海滩？

lines.en: : A private island, actually. I’ve been taking competitive swimming lessons since I was a little girl and am quite confident when it comes to watersports.
lines.zh: ：是私人岛屿。我从小就开始上竞技游泳课，在水上运动方面相当有自信。

lines.en: : Ha.
: Ha?
: Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: ：别在意。

lines.en: : The lower middle class certainly has the strangest sense of humor.
lines.zh: ：下层中产阶级的幽默感果然是奇妙无比。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro10
: But yes, Chika. It is quite strange to be coming to a place like this in the middle of what is one of the coldest winters in Kumon-mi’s recorded history.
lines.zh: ：不过是的，Chika。在 Kumon-mi 有记录以来最冷的冬天之一跑到这种地方来，确实相当奇怪。

lines.en: : I’m not yet entirely accustomed to the traditions of most of you girls, but I’d like to express my concern for your well-being if you truly do intend to swim in this weather.
lines.zh: ：我还没完全习惯你们大多数女生的传统，不过如果你们真打算在这种天气里下水游泳，我想表达一下对你们安危的担忧。

lines.en: : I’m probably not going to bother.
lines.zh: ：我大概是不会去凑这个热闹。

lines.en: : I brought my swimsuit, but...yeah. Not really trying to catch a cold.
lines.zh: ：泳衣我是带了，不过……是啊。我可不想感冒。

lines.en: : That is fine. I’m sure there are plenty of other ways for us to enjoy ourselves.
lines.zh: ：没关系。我相信我们还有很多别的方式可以玩得开心。

lines.en: : You're at least going to try them on, though...right?
lines.zh: ：不过你们至少会试穿一下吧……对吧？

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro11
: Hm? What reason would there be to wear our swimsuits in weather like this? That doesn’t make any sense at all.
lines.zh: ：嗯？这种天气有什么理由要穿泳衣？完全说不通啊。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: ：可是……

lines.en: : But it’s the beach trip...
lines.zh: ：可这是海滩旅行啊……

lines.en: : Sensei, you are making it sound as if your enjoyment of this small vacation hinges entirely upon whether or not the majority of us are dressed down.
lines.zh: ：Sensei，你这话听起来像是说，你这次小长假能不能玩得开心，完全取决于我们大多数人穿得少不少。

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: ：没错。

lines.en: : Uh. My shift with this...thing is over.
lines.zh: ：呃。我轮班看着这个……玩意儿的时间结束了。

lines.en: : Anyone wanna take control so I can go fuckin’...walk around or some shit?
lines.zh: ：谁要来接班？我好去他妈的……随便走走什么的。

lines.en: : Let us walk together! To the highest of highs! The ends of the earth!
lines.zh: ：我们一起走吧！走向至高的高处！走向大地的尽头！

lines.en: : Let us bare it all before he who-
lines.zh: ：让我们在祂面前袒露一切——

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro12
: Yasu!
lines.zh: ：Yasu！

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro13
: Yes, Touka?
lines.zh: ：在，Touka？

lines.en: : If you do not stop terrorizing that girl this instant, you are going to end up with a black eye and medical bill so extravagant that even I would not be able to handle it.
lines.zh: ：你要是现在还不停止折磨那个女孩，你会落得一个黑眼圈，外加一张奢侈到连我都吃不消的医疗账单。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro14
: Just kidding. That was elevated high class humor in which I say things that are untrue and then laugh when I reveal that they actually {i}are{/i} true.
lines.zh: ：开玩笑的。那是高级上流幽默——先说些假话，然后在揭穿它们其实{i}都是{/i}真的时哈哈大笑。

lines.en: : Oh, I crack myself up.
lines.zh: ：哎呀，我可真能逗笑自己。

lines.en: : And on that note, I’m outta here.
lines.zh: ：既然如此，我走了。

lines.en: : Peace.
lines.zh: ：拜拜。

lines.en: : Mind if I tag along?
lines.zh: ：介意我跟着吗？

lines.en: : Is that a fuckin’ joke? Course I mind.
lines.zh: ：你他妈在开玩笑？我当然介意。

lines.en: : Get the fuck away from me, knob goblin.
lines.zh: ：给我滚远点，死变态。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro15
: Don’t be gone too long, okay? I’d like to at least spend {i}some{/i} time with you before the end of the weekend.
lines.zh: ：别去太久，好吗？周末结束前，我至少还想跟你待{i}一会儿{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will, Chika.
lines.zh: ：肯定会的，Chika。

lines.en: : {i}I’m sure you will...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：肯定会的……{/i}

lines.en: : You are quite bad at whispering, Sensei. I can hear you loud and clear.
lines.zh: ：Sensei，你真的很不会说悄悄话。我听得一清二楚。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: ：好吧。

lines.en: : Anyway. Let’s go, Yumi.
lines.zh: ：总之。走吧，Yumi。

lines.en: : The fuck do you mean, “Let’s go, Yumi?!” That’s not a thing you say!
lines.zh: ：你他妈的什么叫「走吧，Yumi」？！这话不是你该说的！

lines.en: : Let’s-
lines.zh: ：走吧——

lines.en: : No! I’m going somewhere {i}alone{/i}! Fuck off!
lines.zh: ：不！我要{i}一个人{/i}去个地方！滚开！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi and I make plans to go somewhere a little more private and-
lines.zh: 我和 Yumi 打算去一个稍微私密点的地方，然后——

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, can’t I get a moment to myself around here?!
lines.zh: ：天啊，这地方就不能让我一个人待会儿吗？！

lines.en: : Of course not. That completely defeats the purpose of this entire trip.
lines.zh: ：当然不能。那整趟旅行的意义就没了。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro16
I walk down what feels like the length of the entire shoreline with Yumi, but is realistically only around half a mile.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Yumi 走了一段感觉像是整条海岸线那么长的路，实际上大概只有半英里。

lines.en: And I technically wasn’t walking {i}with{/i} her. I was walking behind her.
lines.zh: 严格来说我也不是和她{i}一起{/i}走。我是跟在她后面走。

lines.en: But hey, she’s finally slowed down and is now actually looking at me, so that’s a good place to start.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她总算放慢了脚步，现在还真的在看我了，所以这是个不错的开始。

lines.en: : The fuck are you still following {i}me{/i} for when you’ve got an entire yacht full of girls trying to suck your dick?
lines.zh: ：你他妈的还跟着{i}我{/i}干嘛？你不是有一整船的女生排队要给你口交吗？

lines.en: : Touka has the yacht. I’m just a lowly middle class citizen trying to coax a loner into having fun this weekend.
lines.zh: ：游艇是 Touka 的。我只是个卑微的中产阶级市民，想哄一个孤僻鬼这周末过得开心点。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro17
: Oh! Well, in that case, sure! Wanna go get a popsicle and watch the sunrise together?
lines.zh: ：哦！那这样的话，好啊！要不要一起去买根冰棍，一起看日出？

lines.en: : Sure, Yumi. That sounds delightful.
lines.zh: ：好啊，Yumi。听起来真不错。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro18
: No it doesn’t and you fucking know it!
lines.zh: ：才不是，你他妈的心知肚明！

lines.en: : I don’t even like the beach! I’m only here because Chinami kept fuckin’ bitchin’ at me to take a vacation or some shit!
lines.zh: ：我根本不喜欢海滩！我来这儿只是因为 Chinami 一直他妈的在我耳边唠叨，让我去度个假什么的！

lines.en: : Ain’t a fuckin’ vacation if I’m gonna have to deal with you, though!
lines.zh: ：可要是还得应付你，这算他妈的什么假期！

lines.en: : I mean, you should have known something like this was going to happen as soon as you agreed to come.
lines.zh: ：我是说，你答应要来的时候，就该知道会发生这种事。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro19
: Ugh...At least you’re not fuckin’ zoned out this time.
lines.zh: ：呃……至少这次你没他妈的发呆走神。

lines.en: : And I guess it’s {i}technically{/i} easier talkin’ to you than it is that fuckin’ religious cult girl.
lines.zh: ：而且{i}严格来说{/i}，跟你说话是比跟那个信邪教的丫头说话容易些。

lines.en: : I want to take that as a compliment, but Yasu is extraordinarily hard to talk to.
lines.zh: ：我倒想当成夸奖，但 Yasu 确实是难聊到离谱。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro20
: Right? The fuck’s her deal?
lines.zh: ：对吧？她到底什么毛病？

lines.en: : Yasu aside, can I take Chinami’s apparent forcing of you to come here as confirmation that you won’t be leaving after just a few hours again?
lines.zh: ：先不说 Yasu，Chinami 显然是把你硬逼来的，那我是不是可以认为，你这次不会又待几个小时就走？

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro21
: I’ll be here the whole fuckin’ weekend.
lines.zh: ：我他妈会在这儿待满整个周末。

lines.en: : No idea how the fuck I’m gonna sleep in a room full of those other girls, but I managed during the dorm war thing, so I guess I’ll just fuckin’ chill in a corner or some shit.
lines.zh: ：我他妈的也不知道要怎么跟那群女生睡一间房，不过宿舍大战那会儿我也熬过来了，所以大概就他妈的在角落里待着呗。

lines.en: if dormwarfloor1win == True:
: Don’t forget that I’m going to be sleeping in there, too.
lines.zh: ：别忘了我也睡那儿。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro22
: The fuck you mean you’ll be there too?!
lines.zh: ：你他妈的什么意思，你也在？！

lines.en: : That was the prize for the dorm war, remember? And you guys won.
lines.zh: ：那是宿舍大战的奖品，记得吗？而且你们赢了。

lines.en: : That was real?!
lines.zh: ：那是真的？！

lines.en: : Did you think the grand prize was just a joke?
lines.zh: ：你以为头奖只是说着玩的？

lines.en: : I was sure as fuck hoping it was! I can’t sleep in the same room as you!
lines.zh: ：我他妈当然希望是说着玩的！我可没法跟你睡同一间房！

lines.en: : If you’re worried about me assaulting you again, I think I’d sooner do it {i}here{/i} than in a room full of a bunch of witnesses.
lines.zh: ：你要是担心我再对你动手，我觉得我宁可在{i}这儿{/i}动手，也不愿在一屋子目击者面前动手。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro23
: Fuck you.
lines.zh: ：去你的。

lines.en: : We’re not at the level for you to joke about shit like that...and we probably never will be.
lines.zh: ：我们还没到你能拿这种事开玩笑的地步……而且大概永远都不会到。

lines.en: : I’m finally starting to feel less...scared or whatever the fuck you wanna call it around you, and it’s not gonna help if you keep pullin’ that shit.
lines.zh: ：我总算开始在你身边不那么……害怕了，随便你他妈的怎么叫都行，你要是老来这套，可没什么好处。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro24
: But, uhh...
lines.zh: ：不过，呃……

lines.en: : Shit, how do I say this?
lines.zh: ：操，这话该怎么说？

lines.en: : Even though I want you to stay away from me now...
lines.zh: ：虽然我现在想让你离我远点……

lines.en: : There...
lines.zh: ：有件……

lines.en: : There...is kinda somethin’ I’ve been meaning to ask you.
lines.zh: ：有……有件事我一直想问你。

lines.en: : Oh my god.
lines.zh: ：我的天。

lines.en: : What? The fuck do you mean “Oh my god?”
lines.zh: ：什么？你他妈的「我的天」是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean you’re actually going to talk to me for once.
lines.zh: ：我是说，你居然真的要跟我说话了。

lines.en: : This is a big moment.
lines.zh: ：这可是个大时刻。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro18
: You know what?! Nevermind! I don’t need to ask you shit!
lines.zh: ：你知道吗？！当我没说！我他妈的不用问你！

lines.en: : Now run the fuck off and go hang out on your blowjob yacht with the rich girl and her culty ass friend!
lines.zh: ：现在给我滚，去你的口交游艇上，跟那个有钱丫头和她那个邪教朋友混去吧！

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: ：Yumi——

lines.en: : No! Fuck you!
lines.zh: ：不！去你的！

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: ：Yumi——

lines.en: : Shut up!
lines.zh: ：闭嘴！

Pry
lines.zh: 追问

: Did-
lines.zh: ：是不是——

lines.en: : Nothing happened.
lines.zh: ：什么都没发生。

lines.en: : You just said some shit about how I {i}had{/i} to tell you and then stomped over to this fuckin’ log thing.
lines.zh: ：你刚才说了些我{i}必须{/i}告诉你的屁话，然后就气冲冲地走到这根破木头这儿来了。

lines.en: : But...you had that weird look thing again, so...yeah.
lines.zh: ：不过……你又露出那种奇怪的表情了，所以……嗯。

lines.en: Leave her alone
lines.zh: 别管她

scene secondbeachintro25
: Did-
lines.zh: ：是不是——

lines.en: : Nothing happened.
lines.zh: ：什么都没发生。

lines.en: : You just started walkin’ away and...I guess I kinda maybe...chased after you or something.
lines.zh: ：你刚才转身就走，然后……我猜我大概可能……追上来了什么的。

lines.en: : But not cause I wanted to.
lines.zh: ：但不是因为我想追。

lines.en: : Cause you had that...weird look again.
lines.zh: ：因为你的表情又……变得很奇怪。

lines.en: : The one that always happens when...yeah.
lines.zh: ：就是每次都会出现的那种……嗯，你知道的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: ：这样啊。

lines.en: : Thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: ：那……谢了。

lines.en: : It’s whatever.
lines.zh: ：随便吧。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: ：那么——

lines.en: : Are you going to tell me or not?
lines.zh: ：你到底说不说？

lines.en: : Tell you what? Don’t know what you’re talkin’ about.
lines.zh: ：说什么？我不知道你在讲什么。

lines.en: : The thing you said you wanted to ask me.
lines.zh: ：你说想问我的那件事。

lines.en: : Fuck.
: Was hopin’ your wack ass memory or whatever would have left that part out when your brain started goin’ haywire.
lines.zh: ：还指望你那破记性什么的，在你脑子短路的时候能把那段给漏掉呢。

lines.en: : You don’t have to, you know.
lines.zh: ：你其实可以不说。

lines.en: : I really couldn’t care less about whether or not you want me getting involved in your problems.
lines.zh: ：你愿不愿意让我插手你的问题，我真的无所谓。

lines.en: : Why? Cause you’re just gonna involve yourself anyway?
lines.zh: ：为什么？因为反正你都要插手？

lines.en: : No. Because I doubt I can really do anything to fix them.
lines.zh: ：不是。因为我怀疑我根本没法真的解决它们。

lines.en: : I’m just curious and want to know because it’s interesting to me.
lines.zh: ：我只是好奇，想知道，因为我觉得有意思。

lines.en: : Well thanks for bein’ fuckin’ honest at least.
lines.zh: ：行吧，至少谢谢你他妈的说了实话。

lines.en: Time goes by.
lines.zh: 时间流逝。

lines.en: I’m not sure how much, but it’s not a lot.
lines.zh: 我不确定过了多久，但不算久。

lines.en: The wind picks up and the sun refuses to rise.
lines.zh: 风大了起来，太阳却迟迟不肯升起。

lines.en: It tries to, but it’s currently stuck behind layers and layers of clouds.
lines.zh: 它试着升起来，却被一层又一层的云挡住了。

lines.en: I begin to manually blink as my body’s auto-pilot function and the glass panes in front of my eyes do not do enough to protect me from sand or other foreign objects.
lines.zh: 我开始手动眨眼，因为身体的自动驾驶功能和眼前那两片玻璃，并不足以替我挡住沙子或其他异物。

lines.en: Then, a crack in Yumi’s tough outer shell makes its presence known.
lines.zh: 然后，Yumi 坚硬外壳上的一道裂缝显现了出来。

lines.en: An outpouring of light leaks out of her.
lines.zh: 光从她身上倾泻而出。

lines.en: : How about tomorrow?
lines.zh: ：明天怎么样？

lines.en: : What about tomorrow?
lines.zh: ：明天什么？

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro26
: That I fuckin’...tell you or whatever.
lines.zh: ：我他妈的……告诉你之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t normally do this shit, so I’ve gotta like...figure out how.
lines.zh: ：我平时不干这种事，所以我得……琢磨琢磨该怎么做。

lines.en: I resist the urge to joke about whether or not it’s a confession of love because, let’s face it, even this much is kind of a breakthrough for Yumi.
lines.zh: 我忍住了拿「这是不是告白」开玩笑的冲动，因为说实话，光是做到这一步，对 Yumi 来说已经算是一种突破了。

lines.en: One wrong move can turn that crack in her shell into the shape of a spiderweb.
lines.zh: 一步走错，她壳上那道裂缝就会蔓延成一张蛛网。

lines.en: Then, before long, everything will shatter and all of the light will escape at once.
lines.zh: 然后没过多久，一切都会碎裂，所有的光会一次性逃光。

lines.en: And sure, I know that would make things a lot brighter for at least a short period of time.
lines.zh: 当然，我知道那样至少在短时间内会让一切明亮许多。

lines.en: But the slow drip of light particles seeping out otherwise is significantly more appealing to me than any sudden burst of sunshine.
lines.zh: 但相比之下，光粒子一点点慢慢渗出来的过程，对我来说可比突然炸开的阳光有吸引力得多。

lines.en: : Whatever works for you.
lines.zh: ：随你方便。

lines.en: : It’s not like I have anywhere else to be.
lines.zh: ：反正我也没别的地方要去。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for both of us, neither do I.
lines.zh: ：对我们俩都不幸的是，我也没有。

lines.en: : Can’t say I like bein’ stuck with you of all people.
lines.zh: ：我可不敢说我喜欢跟你这个人绑在一起。

lines.en: : I’m still better than Yasu.
lines.zh: ：我总比 Yasu 好。

lines.en: : ‘Least Yasu won’t try to stick her tongue down my throat.
lines.zh: ：至少 Yasu 不会想把舌头伸进我嘴里。

lines.en: : I thought we weren't supposed to joke about that?
lines.zh: ：不是说好不能拿这个开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} not supposed to joke about that.
lines.zh: ：是{i}你{/i}不能拿这个开玩笑。

lines.en: : I can do whatever the fuck I want.
lines.zh: ：我爱怎么来就怎么来。

lines.en: More time goes by.
lines.zh: 又过了一会儿。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro27
Yumi leaves.
lines.zh: Yumi 走了。

lines.en: I don’t chase after her this time.
lines.zh: 这次我没有追上去。

lines.en: I figure that it’s a good move in letting her believe that she “can do whatever the fuck she wants” when I know for a fact that is false.
lines.zh: 我觉得让她相信她「爱怎么来就怎么来」是步好棋，尽管我清楚地知道事实并非如此。

lines.en: The only person who can do everything they want is me.
lines.zh: 唯一一个想做什么就能做什么的人，是我。

lines.en: And, I guess to some extent- Maya.
lines.zh: 大概在某种程度上——还有 Maya。

lines.en: But she’s too wrapped up in Maya things to exert any form of effort on that front.
lines.zh: 但她太忙于自己的 Maya 式事务，没力气在这方面花心思。

lines.en: Basically, those of us with an unlimited amount of time and the knowledge of such a gift may do whatever it is we desire.
lines.zh: 基本上，我们这些拥有无限时间、并且知道自己拥有这份馈赠的人，可以为所欲为。

lines.en: Yumi may {i}try{/i} to do whatever she wants, but she’s closer to that of an unsuspecting mother bird than a fledgling cuckoo.
lines.zh: Yumi 也许想做什么就做什么，但她与其说是一只初生的布谷鸟，不如说是一只毫无戒心的母鸟。

lines.en: She’s far too busy ignoring the things she knows in her heart to be true to make an effort to push anything else aside for her own well-being.
lines.zh: 她太忙于无视那些她心里明知为真的事，以至于不会为了自己的幸福去把别的东西推开。

lines.en: And yet she pushes everything aside anyway.
lines.zh: 可她还是把一切都推开了。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 可为什么呢？

lines.en: Oh, right.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。

lines.en: Because that’s all she ever learned how to do.
lines.zh: 因为那就是她唯一学会的事。

lines.en: If only I could teach her how to be more like me.
lines.zh: 要是我能教她变得像我一点就好了。

lines.en: To toss other eggs outside of the nest.
lines.zh: 把别的蛋扔出巢外。

lines.en: And thrive in an environment you simply don’t belong in.
lines.zh: 然后在一个你根本不属于的地方活得风生水起。

lines.en: scene black
I have no time for such troubling thoughts.
lines.zh: 我没空去想这些烦人的念头。

lines.en: I should be having fun.
lines.zh: 我应该好好玩才对。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro28
I arrive at fun.
lines.zh: 我抵达了「玩」。

lines.en: : Sensei! Good timing!
lines.zh: ：Sensei！来得正好！

lines.en: : Me and Io just got here and have no idea where the heck this resort thingy is supposed to be.
lines.zh: ：我和 Io 刚到，完全不知道这个什么度假村到底在哪儿。

lines.en: : It’s not really a “resort thingy.” It’s just kind of a small beach inn that we rented out a few rooms for.
lines.zh: ：那算不上什么「度假村」。就是个海边小旅馆，我们租了几间房。

lines.en: : And by “we” I mean Ayane and probably Touka.
lines.zh: ：我说的「我们」，指的是 Ayane，大概还有 Touka。

lines.en: : As much as I like this, I absolutely would not pay for it.
lines.zh: ：虽然我挺喜欢这儿的，但我绝对不会为它掏钱。

lines.en: : Do you have your own room, Sensei? Or are you going to be sleeping with the girls the whole weekend?
lines.zh: ：你有自己的房间吗，Sensei？还是说这整个周末都要和女生们一起睡？

lines.en: : If I have my own room, are you going to sneak into it in the middle of the night again?
lines.zh: ：要是我有自己的房间，你半夜还会再偷偷溜进来吗？

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro29
: Mhm. So be careful when you get out of bed so you don’t wind up breaking my leg again. It just healed.
lines.zh: ：嗯。所以你下床的时候小心点，别又把我的腿踩断了。它才刚长好。

lines.en: : Yeah yeah yeah. Keep it in your friggin’ pants.
lines.zh: ：行行行。把你那该死的裤腰带系紧点。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro30
: Now take us to the heckin’ beach resort inn thingy so I can eat my breakfast and listen to whatever it is Makoto’s tryin’ to tell me about.
lines.zh: ：现在带我们去那个什么破海滩度假旅馆，我好吃早饭，顺便听听 Makoto 到底要跟我说什么。

lines.en: : Is she looking for you too?
lines.zh: ：她也在找你？

lines.en: : She’s been textin’ me all morning about a stupid schedule thing.
lines.zh: ：她一早上都在发短信跟我讲什么破日程的事。

lines.en: : Apparently managin’ {i}one{/i} stinkin’ dorm war was enough for her to make me the supreme leader of the second floor. Now I’m in charge of friggin’ everybody.
lines.zh: ：显然，光是管好{i}一{/i}次破宿舍大战，就够她把我封成二楼的最高领袖了。现在我是该死的所有人的头儿。

lines.en: : Ya have any idea how hard it was gettin’ Io to agree to this? Your girl is tired, Sensei. So friggin’ tired.
lines.zh: ：你知道要让 Io 答应来有多难吗？你的女人累了，Sensei。累得要死。

lines.en: scene secondbeachintro31
: Well, whatever you did, I’m glad.
lines.zh: ：嗯，不管你做了什么，我很高兴。

lines.en: : I was just thinking about how I need to have more fun, and there’s certainly never a dull moment with either of you two around.
lines.zh: ：我刚才还在想我得多找点乐子，而只要有你们俩在，绝对不会有沉闷的时候。

lines.en: : You know what would be really fun? If we all-
lines.zh: ：你知道什么会很好玩吗？要是我们一起——

lines.en: : No amusement park, Io. One step at a time.
lines.zh: ：别提游乐园，Io。一步一步来。

lines.en: : Nevermind.
lines.zh: ：算了。

lines.en: scene black
I scan the beach to see if anyone else is around and quickly find that either everyone is already here or we were just way earlier than I thought we were today.
lines.zh: 我扫视海滩看还有没有别人，很快发现：要么大家都已经到了，要么就是我们今天来得比我想的早太多了。

lines.en: Either way, I'm unable to find anyone and wind up showing Uta and Io the way to the inn.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我一个人都没找到，最后就给 Uta 和 Io 指了去旅馆的路。
